what: Production backup tool (tools/backup_bifrost_state.py) proven on the reference store (a real 41 MB Bifrost config.db). Sandbox mode; the reference store is not the live store and is not modified.
method: sqlite3.Connection.backup() from a mode=ro source; service not stopped; source DB not modified
notes: Only names/status are recorded; no credential value is read or printed.

The reference store carries governance_config keys admin_username/admin_password/is_auth_enabled (auth already configured there) — this is why the earlier disposable-store seed test showed auth NOT applied to a store that already had is_auth_enabled. The LIVE store has no auth_config, so the seed will apply.
Backup files and the 41 MB database are NOT committed; only this sanitized summary.
